title: Geocoding permanently degraded
summary: geocoding stayed on fallback responses after a brief provider recovery

logs: geo-client WARN circuit open; request rejected
deployments: geo-client v2.3 changed breaker probe interval 30s -> 0

runbooks.title: Circuit breaker never probes
runbooks.content: A breaker that remains open after dependency recovery needs a nonzero half-open probe policy.

oracle.root_cause: A zero-second-disabled probe configuration prevented the geocoding circuit breaker from testing recovery.
